summary: Artefact rates: TypeScript 0/40 (0.0%), Rust 13/40 (32.5%; extra 13/20, 11 of them tokei, whose build.rs-generated `LanguageType` rust-analyzer cannot resolve with build scripts off, and 2 in nextest; missing 0/20), Go 17/58 (29.3%; extra 3/18, missing 14/20 on the full closure, 0/20 on the closure without function-value edges). The wrong extra pairs that were lidx errors: TypeScript 20/20 `bare_name` joins of a standard-library method to an in-repo method of the same name; Go 15/18 interface-dispatch fan-out to implementers that cannot be the receiver's dynamic type; Rust 7/20 `bare_name`. Every sampled missing pair of TypeScript, Rust and the Go diagnostic closure was a real chain lidx lacks (calls through typed members, trait dispatch, function values, an interface hop that costs a depth level).
